source: Previous interview dataset, original annual ghost measure and original Compustat links. No new classifications or Loujaina data.
primary_measure: Existing original p_it_ebayes from ghost_compustat_merged2.csv; unchanged original labels and smoothing. Raw share sensitivity.
activity: Consecutive-year change in log(1 + annual interview-review count annualized using original exposure adjustment). Not job-ad counts.
primary_sample: Unique one-to-one folder/gvkey-year links; USD; fiscal year ends December; t and t-1 interior observed review years; >=5 reviews in both years; consecutive annual financial records t-1,t,t+1.
primary_models: Baseline: activity + lagged outcome changes and financial controls + industry/year effects
Interaction: baseline + ghost share + activity*ghost share
Direct outcomes: ghost share + controls + industry/year effects
controls: Asset-scaled changes in operating earnings, sales, SG&A, employment, capex, R&D, advertising during t relative to t-1; book-to-market level. Missing R&D/advertising remain missing in full benchmark-control specification; a separately labeled core specification omits those two controls.
inference: Firm-clustered standard errors, two-sided tests, 95% CIs. Holm adjustment across four outcome interaction p-values per specification. Estimate baseline and interaction on identical samples.
sensitivity: Fewer than 250 collected reviews (not proof of uncensored counts)
Both directions of disjoint random review splits
classification_checks: Recompute deterministic score against stored flag; offer override consistency; conservative direct-evidence-only rule; blinded independent human review sample prepared, not completed.
interpretation: Negative interaction is the proposed attenuation pattern, conditional on activity having a positive baseline signal. Standalone ghost association is supporting evidence, not proof of valid identification. Capped, selectively reported interview counts may not track actual recruiting.
output_policy: Report all four outcomes and prespecified sensitivities. Preserve existing separate-sample tables and clearly label old-data checks. No claiming human validation or exact Lourie replication.
status: Interview-activity adaptation estimated; exact posting benchmark remains unestimated; human classification review pending.

sample.sample_rule: Original panel; December year ends, USD, interior consecutive review years, at least five reviews in both years. Finances joined by gvkey and exact year.
sample.cap_interpretation: All original company collections are below 300 retained reviews; below-250 sensitivity is a lower-collection-size comparison, not proof of uncensored recruitment counts.

classification_consistency.interpretation: Checks reproducibility of scoring, not classification accuracy. Saved panel vintage/date processing differs from reconstructing annual counts directly from original review years. Both are reported.
classification_consistency.human_validation: Not completed. A blinded original-data review sample is prepared separately.

additional_safeguards.timing: After primary results, before these safeguard fits
purpose: Use disjoint original reviews for activity and ghost share, reducing shared-review arithmetic.
Hold the full-control sample fixed while omitting R&D and advertising controls.
additional_safeguards.selection_rule: Report both random split directions and all four outcomes, regardless of signs or p-values.

units: Employment in thousands, monetary variables in millions; future changes divided by current assets. Predictor years in the main sample: 2011â€“2023.
fixed_effects: Two-digit SIC industry and year; company and year effects in a separate sensitivity.
original_prior: Retained original smoothing uses full-history firm review shares, including later reviews. The unsmoothed-share sensitivity avoids this prior. This is an association check, not an out-of-sample forecasting exercise.
